title: Yeasty Gooey Venezuelan Spaghetti Pasta
description: A plant-based Venezuelan dish featuring spaghetti, kombu cold extract, and a yeasty sauce, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters looking for a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, combine the kombu cold extract, nutritional yeast, and olive oil, and blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the blended kombu mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes.
Drain the cooked spaghetti and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the spaghetti to a baking dish and top with vegan mozzarella shreds.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
